title: EchoCoT: Extracting Hidden Chain-of-Thought from Large Reasoning Models
abstract: arXiv:2608.20055v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Hidden chain-of-thought (CoT) traces, especially those from frontier proprietary large reasoning models (LRMs), are valuable model assets. Yet whether these hidden CoTs can be directly extracted from black-box models remains largely unexplored. In this work, we systematically study whether hidden CoTs can be extracted near-verbatim from black-box LRMs through API interactions. We identify a previously overlooked reasoning replay surface between tool calls and develop EchoCoT, a multi-step attack that iteratively extracts hidden CoTs using API-returned fidelity signals. We further develop an LLM-based optimization framework that automatically searches for an effective universal injection trajectory across various datasets. We evaluate EchoCoT on three open-source and five frontier proprietary LRMs. On open-source LRMs, EchoCoT achieves up to 66.4\% near-verbatim extraction success, with the extracted trace length within 10\% of the targ

translated_title: EchoCoT：从大型推理模型中提取隐藏的思维链
translated_abstract: 摘要：隐藏的思维链（CoT）痕迹，尤其是来自前沿专有大型推理模型（LRMs）的痕迹，是宝贵的模型资产。然而，这些隐藏的CoT是否能直接从黑盒模型中提取，在很大程度上仍未被探索。在这项工作中，我们系统研究了是否可以通过API交互从黑盒LRMs中近乎逐字地提取隐藏的CoT。我们识别了一个先前被忽视的工具调用之间的推理重放表面，并开发了EchoCoT，这是一种多步攻击方法，利用API返回的保真度信号迭代提取隐藏的CoT。我们进一步开发了一个基于LLM的优化框架，该框架自动搜索跨各种数据集的有效通用注入轨迹。我们在三个开源和五个前沿专有LRMs上评估了EchoCoT。在开源LRMs上，EchoCoT实现了高达66.4%的近乎逐字提取成功率，提取的轨迹长度在目标的10%以内。
tldr: EchoCoT提出了一种通过API交互从黑盒大型推理模型中近乎逐字提取隐藏思维链的多步攻击方法，在开源模型上实现了高达66.4%的提取成功率。
en_tdlr: EchoCoT proposes a multi-step attack method to extract hidden chain-of-thought traces near-verbatim from black-box large reasoning models via API interactions, achieving up to 66.4% extraction success on open-source models.
